objective: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.

description: I have spent ages watching this site.  I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall.  But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.
Prove it to me.  Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great warrior.  Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.
If so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.
Here is a parchment with the items I need.
progress: Do you have the items, <name>? Gathering them is the proof I need that you have the strength to face Cyclonian.
completion: You have gathered the items for my spell, and have shown me your strength and cunning. But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.
Let us hope your strength does not falter.
